name: Uma no Prince-sama
source:
Will you be my owner?-

There stands a horse with a handsome human face.

Before you know it, you agree to start training him...

Is this a dream or a nightmare?

Life on this strange ranch awaits...

[From [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/my-horse-prince/id1173408461]App Store[/url]]
translation:
“你愿意当我的主人吗？”

眼前站着一匹马，却长着英俊的人脸。

不知不觉间，你答应开始训练他……

这究竟是梦境，还是噩梦？

奇异牧场上的生活正等着你……

[来源：[url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/my-horse-prince/id1173408461]App Store[/url]]
